question: In April 2025, which defence subsidiary signed a landmark defence MoU with Slovakia aimed at boosting India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities?

options.text: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Ltd

solution:
The correct answer is __**Airbornics Defence & Space Pvt Ltd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In April 2025, **Airbornics Defence & Space Pvt Ltd**, a defence subsidiary, signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Slovakia to strengthen India’s indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities.
 
• The MoU focuses on collaboration in advanced defence technologies, including weapon systems, aerospace components, and communication systems.
 
• Airbornics Defence & Space Pvt Ltd aims to leverage this partnership to boost domestic production and reduce reliance on foreign imports in the defence sector.
 
• This agreement aligns with India’s vision of **Aatmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)** by promoting local manufacturing and technological innovation.
 
• The collaboration highlights Slovakia’s interest in India as a key defence partner in the global market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan**

 
 
• Launched by the Indian government to promote self-reliance across various sectors, including defence, manufacturing, and technology.
 
• The initiative emphasizes developing domestic capabilities to reduce dependence on foreign imports.
 
• It includes policy reforms and incentives to encourage local industries and startups to participate in national growth.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of Defence MoUs**
 
 
• Defence MoUs facilitate international collaboration to enhance technological expertise and manufacturing capabilities.
 
• They help establish long-term partnerships and strengthen defence ties between participating countries.
 
• Such agreements contribute to the modernization of armed forces and the integration of cutting-edge technologies.
 
 
 
• **India’s Defence Manufacturing Push**
 
 
• India has been focusing on becoming a global hub for defence manufacturing through initiatives like Defence Industrial Corridors and Make in India.
 
• The Indian government has liberalized FDI in the defence sector to attract foreign investment and expertise.
 
• The Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020 emphasizes indigenous procurement and offsets to benefit local industries.
 
 
 
• **Slovakia’s Defence Industry**
 
 
• Slovakia is known for its expertise in producing advanced weaponry, aerospace components, and communication systems.
 
• The country has a strong history of collaboration in defence technologies with global partners.
 
• Its partnership with India opens avenues for mutual technology transfer and joint ventures.
